papers.title: FIR transmission and resistively detected cyclotron resonances in InSb
papers.abstract: We have developed an experimental setup to simultaneously acquire magneto-transmission spectra and measure the photoconductive response. The low-temperature ($T$=4.2 K) magneto-transmission data for weakly doped InSb in the frequency range 3-15 THz and magnetic fields up to 25 T, shows that the AC conductivity is governed by the classical Drude response. Moreover, the resulting light-induced voltage in this system, consisting of thermoelectric and resistive contributions, both contain features that are related to cyclotron resonances. The frequency dependence of this resonance is in good agreement with $\mathbf{k\cdot p}$ perturbation theory and corresponds to transitions between the first and second Landau level with spin-up electrons. The obtained effective mass $m^{*}(B=0)=0.014m_{e}$, is in line with the value extracted from magneto-transmission experiments. Additionally, we can observe evidence of a fluence-dependent metal-insulator transition in the thermoelectric signal, which suggest that the electronic system becomes less sensitive to the light at higher frequencies.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究InSb中远红外透射与光电压响应中的回旋共振现象。
summary_zh.method: 搭建同时测量磁透射光谱和光导响应的实验装置，分析低频磁场下InSb的交流电导率。
summary_zh.result: 观察到了与k·p微扰理论一致的回旋共振，提取有效质量为0.014me，并发现依赖通量的金属-绝缘体转变。
summary_zh.validation: 理论与实验对比，磁透射和光电压数据一致。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate cyclotron resonances in InSb via simultaneous far-infrared transmission and photoconductive measurements.
summary_en.method: An experimental setup was developed to acquire magneto-transmission spectra and measure photoconductive response at low temperatures and high magnetic fields.
summary_en.result: Cyclotron resonances consistent with k·p perturbation theory were observed, yielding an effective mass of 0.014m_e, and a fluence-dependent metal-insulator transition was detected.
summary_en.validation: Experimental magneto-transmission data and photovoltage signals were compared with theoretical predictions.

papers.title: Anharmonic lattice dynamics study of phonon transport in layered and molecular-crystal indium iodides
papers.abstract: Indium iodides, which adopt layered or molecular-crystal-like arrangements depending on composition, are expected to exhibit low lattice thermal conductivity because of their heavy constituent atoms and weak In-I bonding. In this work, we employed first-principles anharmonic lattice dynamics calculations to systematically investigate phonon transport in indium iodides from particle- and wave-like perspectives. The calculated lattice thermal conductivities of both materials remained below 1 W/m-K over a broad temperature range. Notably, the influence of wave-like phonon transport differed by composition: in InI3, the wave-like contribution became comparable to the particle-like Peierls contribution, whereas it remained negligible in InI. We also investigated the thermal transport properties of the experimentally reported high-pressure phase of InI3. Motivated by experimental indications of stacking faults and partial disorder in indium site occupancy within the rhombohedral phase, we constructed several ordered structural models with different stacking sequences. These stacking sequences exhibited no significant energetic preference and had similar lattice thermal conductivities, suggesting that in-plane thermal transport is largely governed by the vibrational properties of the In2I6 layers themselves rather than by the specific stacking sequence. These findings provide insight into phonon transport in layered and molecular-crystal systems with structural complexity and contribute to a broader understanding of thermal transport mechanisms in layered and molecular-crystal-like materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究碘化铟层状和分子晶体中低热导率的机制。
summary_zh.method: 采用第一性原理非简谐晶格动力学计算。
summary_zh.result: 两种材料热导率低于1 W/m-K，波状传热影响因组成而异。
summary_zh.validation: 理论计算与实验证据对比。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the origin of low lattice thermal conductivity in layered and molecular-crystal indium iodides.
summary_en.method: First-principles anharmonic lattice dynamics calculations are used to analyze both particle-like and wave-like phonon transport.
summary_en.result: Both InI and InI3 exhibit thermal conductivities below 1 W/m-K over a wide temperature range, with wave-like contributions significant only in InI3.
summary_en.validation: Comparison with experimental indications of stacking faults and partial disorder in the rhombohedral phase.
